Suture packet identification: 5

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A trainee opens a suture with the correct thread but the wrong needle curvature and point for the planned task. Which package check would have prevented this mismatch before the sterile packet was opened?

  1. Confirm the labeled suture diameter
  2. Confirm needle type and dimensions
  3. Check package integrity before use
  4. Check expiry and storage conditions
  5. Read material and absorbability on the label
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Confirm needle type and dimensions

Needle curvature, size and point should suit the intended tissue and task.

Understanding the options

Confirm needle type and dimensions
Needle curvature, size and point should suit the intended tissue and task.
Check package integrity before use
A damaged or wet sterile barrier cannot be assumed to preserve sterility. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Check expiry and storage conditions
Material performance and sterile assurance depend on valid storage and expiry information. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Read material and absorbability on the label
Brand color alone is not sufficient to determine composition, absorption or support duration. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Confirm the labeled suture diameter
Choose the required diameter rather than assuming all packets with similar appearance contain the same thread. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
